rules.saved.en: Saved. Agents do not apply these rules yet.
rules.saved.zh: 已儲存。Agent 尚未套用這些規則。

rules.changed.zh: 已在其他地方變更，請先重新載入再儲存。

rules.autonomy.en: What the agent may do on its own

rules.quotes_and_holds.en: Ask backup suppliers for quotes and to hold stock
rules.quotes_and_holds.zh: 向備援供應商詢價、請對方保留貨

rules.check_ins.en: Set check-ins and track supplier promises
rules.check_ins.zh: 設定確認點，追蹤供應商承諾

rules.reminders_and_calls.en: Remind or call suppliers who go quiet
rules.reminders_and_calls.zh: 供應商沒回應時寄提醒、打電話

rules.reminders_and_calls.note.zh: 第一次寄信，第二次打電話

rules.skip_hedge_with_substitute.en: Skip a hedge when a substitute exists
rules.skip_hedge_with_substitute.zh: 有替代品時，決定不避險

rules.skip_hedge_with_substitute.note.en: Listed on the Decisions page with the reason
rules.skip_hedge_with_substitute.note.zh: 會列在決策頁並說明原因

rules.binding_orders.en: Pay or place a binding order

rules.binding_orders.note.en: Always needs a person. Can’t be given to the agent
rules.binding_orders.note.zh: 一律要人簽，不能開給 agent

rules.formula.en: Failure odds × units at risk × loss per unit > hedge cost → hedge
rules.formula.zh: 失約機率 × 有風險的數量 × 每單位損失 > 避險成本 → 避險

rules.min_share_pct.note.en: Only propose a hedge that costs less than this share of total refunds
rules.min_share_pct.note.zh: 避險成本低於退款總額的這個比例才自動提出

rules.size_percentile.note.en: Percentile of shortfall scenarios, not the average
rules.size_percentile.note.zh: 缺貨情境的百分位，而不是平均值

rules.unit_loss.note.en: Defaults to the product’s refund amount
rules.unit_loss.note.zh: 沒設定時用該產品的退款金額

rules.signers.database.en: The policy facts cannot be read: no database.
rules.signers.database.zh: 無法讀取政策資料：沒有資料庫。

rules.signers.policy.en: No approval policy in force was found in the facts.
rules.signers.policy.zh: 資料中找不到有效的簽核政策。

rules.signers.reader.en: The approval policy reader is not installed here.
rules.signers.reader.zh: 此環境未安裝簽核政策讀取模組。

rules.signers.failed.en: The signer table could not be loaded.

rules.signers.problems.en: Holder names are withheld until a person checks the policy and the org chart.
rules.signers.problems.zh: 在人員確認政策與組織圖之前，不顯示簽核人姓名。

rules.vacant_to_next_level.en: When a signer role is vacant

rules.vacant_to_next_level.note.en: Send to the next level up

rules.remind_hours_before.note.en: Notify again and call the signer
rules.remind_hours_before.note.zh: 再通知一次，並打電話給簽核人

rules.digest_hours_before.en: Digest before the team goes offline
rules.digest_hours_before.zh: 團隊下線前整理待決清單

rules.digest_hours_before.note.en: Send signers one list of everything still open
rules.digest_hours_before.note.zh: 把所有待決事項整理成一張清單寄給簽核人

rules.channels.note.en: Urgent items also go by SMS
